items.fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. Fixed talent Defiled Blood callbackOnTakeDamage runs on the talent owner: if damage source src has EFF_DEFILED_BLOOD, self:heal(dam * getHeal / 100, src). The marked target therefore damages the effect source, which heals for the configured percentage of that damage.

items.source:
You fire a special steamsaw shot with your steamgun(s) at a target for %d%% physical weapon damage.
		The steamsaw will cut into the target, doing %d%% physical weapon damage over 5 turns.
		This talent does not use ammo as it is the ammo.

你使用蒸汽枪发射特殊蒸汽链锯弹，造成 %d%% 物理武器伤害。
		蒸汽链锯会切入目标，在 5 回合内造成 %d%% 物理武器伤害。
		这个技能本身就是弹药，因此不消耗弹药。

items.source:
<<<You feel a gentle warmth in your mind. Something speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#HELLO FRIEND. I AM A STAR FROM FAR AWAY. I HAVE HEARD YOU PRAISING YOUR SUN. WHY NOT PRAISE ME INSTEAD? I AM A MUCH BETTER SUN THAN THAT DULL, LIFELESS GAS ORB IN YOUR VICINITY. PLEASE, ALLOW ME TO DEMONSTRATE MY GOOD INTENTIONS.
items.target:
<<<你在脑海中感受到一阵温和的暖意。有什么存在直接在你的脑海中对你说话！>>>
#YELLOW#你好，朋友。我是一颗来自远方的恒星。我听到了你对太阳的赞美。为什么不改来赞美我呢？比起你附近那颗枯燥乏味、毫无生气的气态球体，我是一颗好得多的太阳。请允许我向你展示我的善意。
items.fixed_context: section=mod-tome/data/chats/avatar-distant-sun-unlock.chat; source_tag=chat; fixed_source=game/modules/tome/data/chats/avatar-distant-sun-unlock.chat@624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63; initial unsolicited contact and escalating demonstration of power; false-friendly alien-star patron becomes controlling and impatient.

items.source: %s talent '%s%s' is energized by the revelation!
items.target: 启示使%s技能'%s%s'的冷却时间缩短了！
items.fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=logSeen. Fixed source PROPHECY_OF_MADNESS.callbackOnTalentPost selects a non-fixed-cooldown talent from eff.src.talents_cd, calls eff.src:alterTalentCoolingdown(tid, -eff.cd), then emits this log. The log therefore names a selected talent whose cooldown is shortened by revelation.

items.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*The two Sorcerers stands before you, shining like the Sun.*#WHITE#
Ah! Our guest is finally here. I take it you found the peak entertaining?
items.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*两个魔法师站在你面前，像太阳一样闪闪发光。*#WHITE#
喔～！我们的客人终于来到了这里。我想你在山巅玩得很尽兴？
items.fixed_context: section=mod-tome/data/chats/sorcerer-fight.lua; fixed_source=commit:624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63; bounded verification of the single revision repaired under senior scope calibration senior-audit-01. The two Sorcerers greet the player on arrival; the closing clause is a sarcastic taunt asking whether the player found the High Peak entertaining. The High Peak is a ten-level combat gauntlet the player fights up, not somewhere to spectate. source_tag=_t.

items.source:
Let us end this meaningless fight. Have you ever heard of a group of people called the Ziguranth?
These rambling madmen think magic should not be permitted to exist! They fear us; they fear our powers.
Let us join forces and crush the fools!
items.target:
让我们结束这场毫无意义的争斗吧。你听说过一个叫伊格兰斯的群体吗？
这群疯言疯语的狂徒认为魔法根本不该被允许存在！他们害怕我们，害怕我们的力量。
让我们联手消灭那些蠢货！

items.source: When this target is damaged %d%% of the damage will also be done to the source of this effect.

items.fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; section=tome-cults/data/timed_effects.lua; source_tag=tformat. Fixed source MARK_OF_TREASON.callbackOnHit calculates linked_damage = cb.value * eff.power / 100, then calls eff.source:takeHit(linked_damage, src). The source therefore receives the configured percentage of damage received by the target.

items.source:
Your skin grows small spikes coated in dark blight.
		When you are hit in melee the attacker starts bleeding black blood for 5 turns that deals %0.2f darkness damage each turn. This effect may only happen once per turn.
		You are empowered by the sight of the black blood, for each bleeding creature in radius 2 you gain 5%% all resistances, limited to %d creatures.
		The damage will scale with your Magic stat.
items.target:
你的皮肤生长出被黑暗和枯萎力量覆盖的尖刺。
		当你被近战攻击命中时，攻击者开始流出黑血，持续 5 回合，每回合造成 %0.2f 暗影伤害。该效果每回合只能触发一次。
		同时，目睹黑血会使你受到强化：2 格范围内每个可见的流着黑血的生物，都使你获得 5%% 全部抗性，最多计 %d 个生物。
		伤害随魔法属性提升。
items.fixed_context: translation: tome-cults.lua; source_tag=tformat; section=tome-cults/data/talents/misc/races.lua. Fixed source Spikeskin callbackOnMeleeHit applies EFF_SPIKESKIN_BLACK_BLOOD. callbackOnActBase counts visible actors with that effect at distance <= 2, caps at talent level, and sets EFF_SPIKESKIN power=5 per actor; SPIKESKIN applies resists={all=eff.power}.
